h2.default: What working with us is like

default.svg_icon: <svg aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#1E58A0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.8" viewBox="0 0 56 56"><circle cx="20" cy="28" r="13"></circle><circle cx="36" cy="28" r="13"></circle></svg>
default.p: Trust is how our team works together and how we build long-term relationships with clients. We earn it through honest, open conversations about a shared goal: a successful program.

default.svg_icon: <svg aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#1E58A0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.8" viewBox="0 0 56 56"><path d="M28 6v8M28 42v8M6 28h8M42 28h8"></path><circle cx="28" cy="28" r="10"></circle></svg>
default.p: Our scientists bring decades of experience across every part of preclinical research, and we apply it to new modalities and models, not just familiar ones.

default.svg_icon: <svg aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#1E58A0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.8" viewBox="0 0 56 56"><path d="M6 28c6-10 14-15 22-15s16 5 22 15c-6 10-14 15-22 15S12 38 6 28Z"></path><circle cx="28" cy="28" r="6"></circle></svg>
default.p: You hear about operational and study details clearly and promptly, including the unexpected ones. Transparency is what makes trust possible.

default.svg_icon: <svg aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#1E58A0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.8" viewBox="0 0 56 56"><path d="M28 47S9 36 9 22a10 10 0 0 1 19-4 10 10 0 0 1 19 4c0 14-19 25-19 25Z"></path></svg>
default.p: High-quality data starts with well-cared-for animals. Our team is committed to humane care in every study we run.
